metadata.name: Dystopian Village Hut 3
metadata.author: matioshka
metadata.description: Straight lines, clean colors and simple details are the keywords of this Dystopian village hut. Matioshka has done a whole bundle of dystopian style houses to give You some inspiration. This hut could make You feel a little claustrophobic but hey, we're still talking about dystopian style here. Take a chance and try it out!
